title: Italo Calvino's birth chart
metaDescription: Italo Calvino's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 21.3° Libra. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Cardinal signs carry four of the nine placements whose signs are settled — the broadest certain weighting in the chart. Cardinal signs open the seasons, and a cardinal-heavy chart is read as one that starts things.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's position resolves to 21.3° Libra — deep enough in the third decan (20°–30°) that Mercury, its traditional sub-ruler, colours the reading.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: Closer in, Mercury stands at 3.4° Libra; Venus stands at 0.7° Scorpio; Mars stands at 28.4° Virgo. The tradition reads thought that travels by comparison from Mercury, attraction that works by atmosphere from Venus, effort banked steadily until it tells from Mars.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Jupiter and Neptune hold the closest angle here — a square, 1.4° wide. Right angles are where the scheme puts its grit. A square asks two functions to work in a mode neither would have chosen. Behind it, the Sun sextile Neptune at 1.4°, and the Sun conjunction Saturn at 1.5° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. All of it stands whatever the hour was: each angle was tested from midnight to midnight before it was written down.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: The Moon makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The dignity table, which predates the outer planets and only ever spoke for seven, marks three placements here. The Sun in Libra at 21.3° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Venus in Scorpio at 0.7° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Saturn in Libra at 22.8° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best. Dignity is a statement about conditions, not about worth.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: The honest balance sheet uses the 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: water 4, air 3, earth 1, fire 1 across the elements, and cardinal 4, fixed 3, mutable 2 across the modalities. A water emphasis reads as porousness: the room is registered whole, long before it is analysed in parts. Uranus and Pluto were retrograde — apparent backward motion from where the Earth sits, which the tradition reads as a function turned inward before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Sagittarius into Capricorn during that day at the birthplace, travelling 13.9° between one midnight and the next. The hour would decide it; no hour was recorded. The reading keeps the question open rather than flipping a coin dressed as astrology.
